-117.81500,33.68630.name: Life IVF Center
-117.81500,33.68630.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Frank D. Yelian, MD, PHD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-2.57211,51.54263.state: Aztec West, Aztec Centre, Almondsbury, Bristol, BS32 4TD
-2.57211,51.54263.company: Satellite clinic to Care Fertility Bath
-2.57211,51.54263.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to Care Fertility Bath. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-84.94976,34.74698.name: B&L Lively LLC

Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones. What is covered here is dogs, cats, primates, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and farm animals. The rest is counted nowhere.

-46.66273,-23.60442.name: Mater Lab
-46.66273,-23.60442.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.materlab.com.br. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.
